config.experiment: A responds to fixed p2; B responds to fixed p1; both start at the same x0
config.scope: Targeted cases with uncovered common initial states in experiment 11; not a new rho sweep

basin.tie_convention: Explicit verified holding points hold. Other attractive roots use the holding mixture. Repelling roots select product 1. Crossing roots select the downstream action. At a root equal to p1 or p2, the corresponding available stationary pure action is selected. Endpoint membership is conditional on this selector; alternative optimal tie selectors may change isolated boundary points, but not the initial_conditions's measure. At a repelling discontinuity the selected action also specifies the immediate forward-event continuation; a Caratheodory (ODE almost everywhere) interpretation alone need not give a unique path from that exact point.
basin.interpretation: Exact phase-line topology for a numerical policy; endpoint values are numerical approximations, not certified bounds.
